ideaTypes.label: Hot Take / Conversation Starter
ideaTypes.description: A provocative or surprising angle from the article that invites replies.

ideaTypes.label: Quick Tip Thread
ideaTypes.description: A 3-5 post thread pulling actionable tips from the article. 500 characters max per post.

ideaTypes.label: One Thing That Surprised Me
ideaTypes.description: Single post highlighting something unexpected from the article.

toneGuidelines: Short, punchy, conversational. Think 'tweet energy' but with room to breathe
Hook in the first line. No preamble
Questions and conversation starters work well. Threads rewards replies
Cultural references and timely takes land here
Casual tone, even more informal than LinkedIn. Can use humor
500 characters per post in a thread. Single posts can be longer
structureRules: Can be a single post OR a 3-5 post thread
For threads: number each post (1/, 2/, etc.)
Link in last post of thread, not first
Each post in a thread should stand alone but connect to the next
hookFormula: Provocative statement or question that stops the scroll. One line max.
hashtagStrategy: No hashtags. Threads does not use them effectively.
